boundaries: Rust recovery tests exercise real local temporary files and threads, not actual process kills or power loss.
Store locks coordinate clones of one RecoveryStore; independent stores and other processes are not locked together.
File sync_all precedes rename; Unix directory sync_all follows rename/removal. No hardware power-loss durability guarantee is claimed.
Controller persistence remains best-effort on I/O errors, logging the failure while retaining in-memory state.
Stream timings use Jest fake timers. Callback counts prove scheduler submission, not Dexie completion or disk durability; event-loop stalls can delay real callbacks.
The 91/320 baseline failure count is one observed concurrent run, not a deterministic failure percentage or statistical benchmark.
No production user database, whole Tauri build, authenticated UI recovery, or cross-platform filesystem was tested by these commands.
